gloss: accounts receivable; money owed by customers

definitions.explanation: Money a business is owed for goods or services it has already delivered on credit. A standard balance-sheet asset account, and the counterpart of {買掛金|かいかけきん}.

examples.japanese: {売掛金|うりかけきん}が{増|ふ}えている。
{今月|こんげつ}の{売掛金|うりかけきん}の{回収|かいしゅう}が{遅|おく}れている。
examples.english: Collection of this month's receivables is running late.

examples.japanese: {取引先|とりひきさき}が{倒産|とうさん}し、{売掛金|うりかけきん}が{回収|かいしゅう}できなくなった。
examples.english: A client went bankrupt, and we became unable to collect the receivable.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}は{伸|の}びているが、{売掛金|うりかけきん}が{膨|ふく}らんで{手元|てもと}の{現金|げんきん}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: Sales are growing, but receivables have swollen and we are short of cash on hand.

notes:
Formed from {売|う}り (selling) + {掛|か}け (on credit) + {金|きん} (money). Used in bookkeeping and everyday business talk alike; ordinary speech often says {未回収|みかいしゅう}のお{金|かね} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}を{回収|かいしゅう}する: to collect a receivable
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}が{残|のこ}る: to have a receivable outstanding
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}の{残高|ざんだか}: receivables balance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買掛金|かいかけきん}: accounts payable — the mirror image, money the business owes
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}: accrued receivable — money owed from something other than normal sales
- {売上|うりあげ}: sales revenue — the sale itself, whether paid in cash or on credit
